purpose.zh: 撑住身子，练两腿收回和伸直
purpose.en: Stay up on your hands and tuck and straighten your legs.

text.zh: 撑住别落地，腿伸直成 L 撑再把膝盖收回来
text.en: Stay up on your hands, straighten into an L, then pull your knees back in

text.zh: 胳膊锁直，两手把地往下推。
text.en: Lock your arms and shove the floor down.

text.zh: 收腿时脚后跟收到身子下面。
text.en: When you tuck, pull your heels in under you.

commonErrors.en: Leaning back instead of tucking your knees.

cautions.zh: 手腕疼就换撑杆或撑拳头，先活动开再做
cautions.en: If your wrists hurt, use parallettes or fists. Warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼就少做点，还疼就停；撑不住就脚跟点地做
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, do less. Stop if it still hurts. Can't stay up? Keep your heels touching the floor.
